# Brain / Cognitive Type Check (tendency inference)

> Answer 50 questions and the app infers which of 16 brain/cognitive-type tendencies
> you are closest to. Fully client-side, no backend, no data leaves the browser.
> Not a medical diagnosis or a brain measurement — a self-check for self-understanding.

Static HTML + vanilla JS with a local scoring module (pytest-style tests cover
scoring and integration). Japanese is primary; English pages live under /en/.

## Pages

- [Type check (50 questions)](https://neuro-profile.pages.dev/): the quiz. Auto-detects language; English version at /en/.
- [Type list (16 types, 4 groups)](https://neuro-profile.pages.dev/types.html): 探索×直感・探索×分析・警戒×直感・警戒×分析. English at /en/types.html.
- [Type detail](https://neuro-profile.pages.dev/type.html): the selected type's profile. English at /en/type.html.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/sunnydachs/neuro-profile): MIT, vanilla JS scoring, Cloudflare Pages + Functions, CI on Node 18/20/22.
